name: teltonika_ftc305
description: AVL parameters Traccar's Teltonika decoder leaves as raw io<id> values, from the Teltonika Telematics wiki page for the FTC305. Generated from the published table: units and multipliers are taken from it directly. Opaque payloads (Manual CAN), identifiers (MAC address, Name, Dallas sensor IDs) and high-churn cell data are set to ignore so they do not flood the recorder.
